sections.Profile:
Run Aperture Science's test chambers under the watch of GLaDOS, taking objectives in a central Hub mode from a Personality Core named Reggie and finishing with a face-to-face battle against GLaDOS herself. Built for Multimorphic's P3 platform, the game hides illuminated portals beneath two lifting ramps, uses a Companion Cube to enable physical ball locks on the upper playfield, and has Ellen McLain reprising her role from the video games.
